description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pujanagaraya, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710077
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights in the Village of Pujanagaraya, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
